==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*per-|id1=before|*tḱey-}}{{word|en|ine|*h₂epó}} From {{inh|en|enm|proposen}}, from {{der|en|xno|proposer|pos=v}}, {{m|fro|propos|pos=n}}, {{der|en|frm|proposer|pos=v}}, {{m|frm|propos|pos=n}}, from {{der|en|la|propono|prōpōnō, prōpōnere}}, with conjugation altered based on {{m|fro|poser}}. {{doublet|en|propound}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/pɹəˈpəʊz/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/pɹəˈpoʊz/|a=GenAm,CA}} * {{IPA|en|/pɹəˈpoʊz/|[pɹəˈpəʊz]|a=California|q2=California Vowel Shift}} ** {{audio|en|En-us-propose.ogg|a=California Vowel Shift}} * {{IPA|en|/pɹəˈpəʉz/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|[pɹəˈpɐʉz]|a=NZ}} * {{rhymes|en|əʊz|s=2}} ===Verb=== {{wikidata lexeme|L78}} {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[suggest]] a plan, course of action, etc. #: {{syn|en|put forth|suggest|project|forthput|q3=rare}} #: {{ux|en|I '''propose''' going to see a film.}} #: {{ux|en|to '''propose''' an alliance}} #: {{ux|en|to '''propose''' a question for discussion}} #* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Gregory Krieg and Will Mullery|title=Trump’s budget by the numbers: What gets cut and why|url=https://www.cnn.com/2017/05/23/politics/trump-budget-cuts-programs/index.html|date=2017-05-23|passage=“The Budget '''proposes''' eliminating Supporting Effective Instruction (SEI) State Grants (Title II State grants), a program that provides formula funds to States to improve the quality and effectiveness of teachers, principals, and other schools leaders. SEI grants are poorly targeted and funds are spread too thinly to have a meaningful impact on student outcomes.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260808001538/https://www.cnn.com/2017/05/23/politics/trump-budget-cuts-programs/index.html|archivedate=8 August 2026}} # {{lb|en|intransitive|sometimes followed by '''to'''}} To ask for a person's hand in [[marriage]]. #: {{ux|en|He '''proposed''' to her last night and she accepted him.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=1960 March|author=N. Caplan|title=The Railway Member of Parliament|journal=Railway Magazine|page=208|text=After the death of his [Verney's] first wife, he '''proposed''' to Florence Nightingale but she refused him. Later he married her sister, and for many years Claydon was Miss Nightingale's second home.}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[intend]]. #: {{ux|en|He '''proposes''' to set up his own business.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1859|author=w:John Gorham Palfrey|title=History of New England|sectionurl=http://books.google.ca/books?id=0fkUAAAAYAAJ&pg=PR7&dq=%22I+propose+to+relate,+in+several+volumes+the+history+of+the+people+of+New+England%22&hl=en&sa=X&ei=962LUvW7Hqak2AXjvIGADQ&ved=0CDMQ6AEwAQ#v=onepage&q=%22I%20propose%20to%20relate%2C%20in%20several%20volumes%20the%20history%20of%20the%20people%20of%20New%20England%22&f=false|section=Preface (Google preview) |passage=I '''propose''' to relate, in several volumes, the history of the people of New England.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-08-16|author=[http://www.theguardian.com/profile/johnvidal John Vidal] |volume=189|issue=10|page=8|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2013/aug/10/china-india-water-grab-dams-himalayas-danger Dams endanger ecology of Himalayas] |passage=Many of the '''proposed''' dams would be among the tallest in the world.}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} To talk; to [[converse]]. #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Much Ado About Nothing|3|1|text=HERO. Good Margaret, run thee to the parlour;
There shalt thou find my cousin Beatrice
'''Proposing''' with the prince and Claudio}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} To set forth. #* {{RQ:Homer Chapman Iliads|year=1843|11|text={{...}}so weighty was the cup,
That being '''propos'd''' brimful of wine, one scarce could lift it up.}} ====Usage notes==== * In use 1, this is sometimes a [[catenative]] verb that takes the ''gerund (-ing)''. * In use 3, this is a [[catenative]] verb that takes the ''to infinitive''. * For more information, see [[Appendix:English catenative verbs]] * Compared to ''to suggest'', ''to propose'' is more deliberate and definite. To suggest is merely to mention, while to propose is to have a definite plan and intention. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|counterpropose|prompose|proposable|proposee|repropose|unproposing|proposal|propose marriage|proposement}} ====Related terms==== * {{l|en|proponent}} * {{l|en|proposition}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|to suggest a plan or course of action}} * Arabic: * Breton: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Interlingua: * Italian: * Japanese: * Korean: * Kurdish: * Latin: * Lithuanian: * Māori: * Naga: * Norman: * Norwegian: * Old English: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|предлага́ть|impf}}, {{t+|ru|предложи́ть|pf}} * Sami: * Scots: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Thai: * Turkish: * Vietnamese: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top-also|to ask for someone's hand in marriage|ask for someone's hand in marriage}} * Arabic: * Bulgarian: * Cebuano: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Indonesian: * Italian: * Japanese: * Korean: * Kurdish: * Lithuanian: * Naga: * Norwegian: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t|ru|де́лать предложе́ние|impf}}, {{t+|ru|сде́лать предложе́ние|pf}} {{qualifier|+ [[dative case]]}};
